name: Kondotec Inc.
summary: Kondotec Inc. engages in the manufacture, procurement, import, sale, wholesale, and export of industrial materials primarily in the retail hardware business in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Industrial Materials, Steel Construction Materials, Electrical Equipment Materials, and Scaffolding Construction. Its products include turn buckles, braces, scaffolding chains, screws, anchor bolts, construction materials, and machinery and equipment; and merchandise comprising hardware, chains, wire ropes, screws, lighting equipment, panel boards, air-conditioning equipment, and eco items.
